How to obtain:

Participate in an Emergency Capital Increase event (use tinyurl.com/RailwayUWO guide schedule to watch for this event's occurrence) and invest ducats in a train company. After the ECI's conclusion, the total investment amounts from ECI will be tallied and the top ranked player will be able to claim this.

Effect: Title owner can receive 3 benefits from all railway companies when this title is equipped. The title will be lost in future ECI events if the past top investor fails to participate and reach #1 investor rank again.

Note: Only the amount of ducats invested from the start of ECI until its end will be counted; past investment amounts (if any) will not be counted towards top investor rank.
